wood_dragon.label: Wood dragon: his dragon out of his Wood Dragon icon (each of his pixels 2x2): sway, strike (his head comes down to the left), break (it falls apart); anchor: the ground under its trunk

wood_root.label: Wood root: the near half of his left coil and its mirror, a root arching out of the ground (anchor: the ground under the arch)

wood_leaves.label: Wood leaves: his loose leaves from the icon flung up and out of the ground point and falling (anchor: the ground point)
